name: superset-factory
description: In-repo Slack + Grok software factory for Apache Superset (AI-first SDLC).

scripts.check: npm run check --workspace=orchestrator && npm run check --workspace=product && npm run check --workspace=design && npm run check --workspace=architect && npm run check --workspace=implementer && npm run check --workspace=reviewer && npm run evals:check
scripts.deploy:dry-run: for d in agents/*/; do npx --yes @grok/agent-sdk@0.6.0 deploy --dir "$d" --dry-run --json; done
